title: Receipted delivery: Codex pre-send early exits record a Rejected delivery outcome
outcome: Receipted delivery: Codex pre-send early exits record a Rejected delivery outcome
acceptance: Every Codex dispatch exit that returns before turn/start is written settles a receipted prompt's delivery as Rejected (pending while its head is still queued), never leaving it to become Ambiguous
A test drives each such pre-send exit and asserts the receipt is not Ambiguous and nothing reached Codex
